title: The Lead
plot: Many years ago, the county troupe was recruiting students. Sanyuan Hu, who was the drummer in the troupe, signed up for his niece and brought her from her hometown to learn Qinqiang. The accident caused by Sanyuan Hu affected Qin'e Yi, and her journey to learn Qinqiang was full of twists and turns. But she won the appreciation and enthusiastic support of old artists with her hard work and her own conditions. Her "Break Meng Opera" shocked the audience on the rural stage, and she was later transferred to the provincial Qinqiang troupe by changing her name to Qin'e Yi. She studied hard and practiced hard, and her performances on stage were successful. After twists and turns, she finally realized that the inheritance of Qinqiang art is the true meaning of her as a "protagonist", and she will continue to cultivate a new generation of bright protagonists on the Qinqiang stage.
